eas.shortDesc: Hello, traders! I am Quantum Queen, the crown jewel of the entire Quantum ecosystem and the highest-rated, best-selling Expert Advisor in the history of MQL5.
eas.fullDesc:
Why Traders Call Me the Best GOLD EA Ever Created
I’m the next-generation trading engine, crafted with precision, vision, and years of real market experience. Traders all over the world trust me because I’m built differently:

12 advanced built-in strategies, each designed for a different market condition, working together like a perfectly synchronized machine. When one strategy sleeps, another awakens — ensuring I always adapt intelligently.
4 different sets to choose from, each customised for 4 different brokers (VT Markets/IC Markets RAW - Medium Risk,  VT Markets/IC Markets RAW - Low Risk, Roboforex ECN, Fusion Zero)
The elite trend-following grid system that doesn’t chase noise — it captures structured momentum and builds positions with intention, not randomness.
15+ years of real trading expertise baked into my logic, giving me the instincts of a seasoned trader combined with the discipline of an algorithm.
A complete, unwavering focus on quality over quantity — my signature strength that allows me to stay patient, avoid unnecessary trades, and strike only when the market truly aligns.
I don’t trade for the sake of trading. I don’t gamble. I don’t guess.

I wait. I analyze. And when the probabilities line up… I strike with precision, often turning a single move into an entire sequence of calculated, profitable decisions.

This is why my performance stands out above everything else on the marketplace — consistency, discipline, precision, and real, verifiable long-term results.



How I Work — Smart, Precise, and Effortless
I am designed to integrate seamlessly into any trader’s workflow, whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned professional. My goal is to remove complexity, eliminate guesswork, and trade with discipline that most humans struggle to maintain.

Here’s how I operate:

Plug & Play installation — simply attach me to your XAUUSD chart, choose your preferred risk level, and the recommended set and I take care of the rest. No headaches, no chaos, no endless fine-tuning.
No complicated settings — all 12 strategies and internal logic are fully optimized. You don’t need to modify anything. I come “battle-ready,” straight out of the box.
Multi-timeframe flexibility — I work flawlessly on any timeframe.
24/5 market intelligence — I constantly monitor gold’s price behavior, volatility spikes, directional bias, and trend structure. When I detect the perfect alignment of probabilities, I execute with razor-sharp accuracy.
I don’t flood your account with trades. I don’t chase noise. And I definitely don’t rely on luck.
I trade when the market conditions match my strategic criteria, not when someone feels impatient.
That’s why I don’t trade every day — and that’s exactly why my long-term results stand above the rest.

Patience is my edge. Quality is my signature. Consistency is my legacy.
Minimum requirements and recommendations
Recommended brokers: VT MARKETS / FP TRADING or a broker with ECN/RAW/LOW spread type
2 decimal price quota for GOLD. Quantum Queen is not compatible with brokers which offer a 3 decimal price quota for GOLD
Minimum initial deposit: $500 in accounts with 1:500 leverage.
Recommended initial deposit: $1000 in accounts with 1:500 leverage.
Leverage at least 1:100, 1:500 recommended
Account type: Hedging.
Use a VPS for the EA to work 24/7 (Mandatory).

Designed for Traders Who Want More
My code is fast.
My logic is battle-tested.
My performance is proven in real live markets — not just backtests.

Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned trader, I bring you the most powerful, refined trading experience that is hard to match.

Just set me up, let me do my job, and enjoy the results.
I am Quantum Queen — and your gold trading will never be the same again. 

DISCLAIMER:
Trading foreign exchange and CFDs carries a high level of risk. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Please trade responsibly and test on a demo account first.
Quantum Queen focuses on high quality setups, rather than blindly trading. It is not a high frequency trading system - it's the ultimate system that patiently waits and executes only when it sees the perfect market conditions. This means that there will be entire days with no trades at all and other days with higher trading activity, entirely depending on the market conditions - this behavior can also be seen in my live signal, in backtesting and in the reviews/feedback left by long-term users.
The main priority Of Quantum Queen is capital preservation first - it does not execute risky trades, it only executes in the perfect moments.
Trading with Quantum Queen requires you to be patient and don't expect high trading activity and to get rich fast - this is a professional tool made for people who know the value of money.
